title_card.title: Aida R5 in Isaac Sim: what it can do so far
lines: Every clip is a physics take (PhysX 5 in Isaac Sim 6): planned, then run with the robot's own controller
Speeds are marked on each clip

chapters.title: A recorded grasp, replayed
lines: HomeHero's recorded R5 grasp played through its gravity-compensated action layer in Isaac Sim 6
chapters.result: PASS: the red mug lifted 7.0 cm and held

segments.caption: a recorded grasp, replayed in PhysX

chapters.title: Its own grasp, planned
lines: HomeHero's grasp planner against the scene's point cloud
chapters.result: PASS: the can lifted 5.8 cm, 0.2 mm drift in the hand

segments.caption: planned, descended, closed, lifted

chapters.title: A pinch: a chess move
lines: A fingertip pinch carries a pawn e2-e4 between its neighbours
chapters.result: PASS: the pawn on e4, 1.6 cm from the square's centre, upright; no other piece moved

segments.caption: pinched, carried a square on, set down and let go

chapters.title: Scissors: two hands
lines: Scissors taken off their peg; the other hand works their pivot
chapters.result: PASS: lifted 7 cm off the peg; the blades closed and opened by the right hand

segments.caption: the left hand takes the scissors off their peg
the right hand pushes the blades shut
and presses them open

chapters.title: A fridge door, past its gasket
lines: A sourced magnetic-gasket law: 35 N at the handle to break the seal
chapters.result: PASS: seal broken, the door pulled to 34 deg (planned 34)

segments.caption: the handle gripped and the door pulled open through the gasket

chapters.title: A microwave: button, latch, door
lines: The release button trips the latch and a spring kicks the door open; then the door is pulled wide by its edge
chapters.result: PASS: the button pressed 6.7 mm, the latch tripped, the door to 71 deg

segments.caption: the release button pressed: the latch lets go, the door kicks open
then pulled wide by its free edge

chapters.title: A drill drives a screw
lines: A motor law on the trigger, a #8 screw law in birch plywood: the screw advances a pitch a turn and seats
chapters.result: PASS: driven 26.8 mm in 15.8 turns, seated, not stripped

segments.caption: the drill picked up by its grip
the bit looked at, put in the screw's recess, and the screw driven home

chapters.title: The drill's switch, then its trigger
lines: The direction switch set by the hand, then the drill gripped and run
chapters.result: PASS: switch set by the hand; the chuck at 289 rpm, as the motor law says for that pull

segments.caption: the direction switch pressed
then the drill gripped and its trigger pulled: the chuck runs

chapters.title: An asset the pipeline approved
lines: A pill bottle classified, scaled, given its mass and materials, approved by the review hub, then picked

segments.caption: a newly approved asset picked up

chapters.title: HomeHero's first lab lesson
lines: A sealed container moved from the receiving bench to the inspection bench in a generated lab
chapters.result: PASS: on the inspection bench's region, 1.6 mm from its centre, upright, let go

segments.caption: taken from one bench and set down on the other

chapters.title: A tablet into the vial, with tweezers
lines: Tweezers from their cradle in a tripod; the tips closed on an 8 mm tablet on its stand, carried, let go over the open vial
chapters.result: PACK PASS: held 8.18 mm apart at 1.18 N, carried 11 cm, inside the vial

segments.caption: the tweezers taken from their cradle in a tripod grip, on their cushion grips
re-planned over the tablet from where the tips really are; closed until they hold it
carried over the vial's mouth and let go: it drops in

chapters.crop_why: a zoom on the work, clear of the film's head-camera inset (x >= 880, y >= 416)

chapters.title: The vial opened
lines: A screw cap on a one-turn thread: seated it holds at half the torque it was closed with (Oberk: 40-60 %)
chapters.result: CAP PASS: broke loose at 0.152 N m, turned 375 deg in 5 strokes, lifted 40 mm clear

segments.caption: the cap gripped low on its skirt and turned until it breaks loose
80-degree strokes: let go, turn back, grip again - it rises 4.2 mm a turn
the last stroke takes it off the thread; lifted away

chapters.crop_why: a zoom on the work, clear of the film's head-camera inset (x >= 880, y >= 416)

chapters.title: The vial closed again
lines: The cap set loose on the neck; the thread catches it and the hand screws it down
chapters.result: CAP PASS: seated; closed at 0.351 N m - its next hold 0.176 N m

segments.caption: the cap set on the neck at the thread's start, gripped and turned
screwed down stroke by stroke
seated: the torque it is closed with is what holds it next time

chapters.crop_why: a zoom on the work, clear of the film's head-camera inset (x >= 880, y >= 416)
